q1.title: Wrist test
q1.instruction: Grasp one wrist — where the palm meets the forearm — with your other hand. Watch how the thumb and index finger of the grasping hand meet.
q1.ariaLabel: Wrist test: an animation of grasping one wrist (where the palm meets the forearm) with the other hand and judging bone size by how the thumb and index finger meet

H.label: Fingers overlap
H.description: The thumb and index finger of the grasping hand overlap each other — small, slender bones.

S.label: Tips just touch
S.description: The two fingertips meet exactly, with no gap or overlap — medium bones.

B.label: Tips don't touch
B.description: The fingertips cannot reach each other — large, broad bones.

q2.title: Recall your weight history
q2.instruction: Think back over your weight for the last 1–2 years. How does your weight change when you eat more or less?
q2.ariaLabel: Weight test: an animation showing how stable your weight is by the way the scale needle moves

H.label: Doesn't go up
H.description: Weight doesn't increase even when eating a lot, and drops easily.

S.label: Stable
S.description: Weight adjusts easily to how much you eat.

B.label: Doesn't come down
B.description: Weight goes up easily even when eating little, and is slow to lose.

q3.title: Skin pinch test
q3.instruction: Gently pinch and stroke the skin of your forearm. Notice its dryness, warmth and moisture.
q3.ariaLabel: Skin test: an animation of pinching the forearm skin to judge its quality

H.label: Dry, rough
H.description: Feels dry; flaky bits may be visible.

S.label: Warm, reddens
S.description: Feels warm, and the pinched spot reddens easily.

B.label: Soft, moist
B.description: Feels cool, soft and moist; the skin is thick and smooth.

q4.title: Weather test
q4.instruction: Picture a cold winter, a hot summer and a damp, rainy day. Which one bothers you most?
q4.ariaLabel: Weather test: an animation comparing which of snow, sun and rain bothers you most

H.label: Cold
H.description: Suffers most in the cold — prefers warm places and sunshine.

S.label: Heat
S.description: Suffers most in the heat — likes a cool breeze and shade.

B.label: Damp, wet
B.description: Suffers most in humid weather — prefers dry warmth.

q5.title: A week of sleep observation
q5.instruction: Think back over your sleep last week: how many hours did you sleep, did you wake at night, and how did you feel getting up in the morning?
q5.ariaLabel: Sleep test: an animation showing the hours slept and waking during the night

H.label: Light, short
H.description: 5–6 hours is enough; wakes several times a night.

S.label: Regular
S.description: A regular 7–8 hours; easy to fall asleep and easy to get up.

B.label: Deep, long
B.description: Sleeps deeply for 9+ hours; hard to get up in the morning.

q6.title: Skipped meal test
q6.instruction: Recall what your body feels when you skip lunch.
q6.ariaLabel: Digestion test: an animation showing how the flame of hunger changes when a meal is skipped

H.label: Irregular
H.description: Sometimes not hungry at all, sometimes suddenly hungry.

S.label: Gets hungry fast
S.description: Gets hungry fast, becomes irritable and can't focus on work.

B.label: Barely notices
B.description: Feels nothing in particular — can go a long time without getting hungry.

q7.title: Observe your walk and speech
q7.instruction: Recall who leads when you walk with someone, and how fast you speak.
q7.ariaLabel: Pace test: an animation showing walking speed changing

H.label: Fast
H.description: Walks fast and talks a lot; jumps from topic to topic.

S.label: Decisive
S.description: Walks with purpose and speaks clearly and sharply.

B.label: Calm
B.description: Walks slowly and calmly; thinks first and speaks in few words.

q8.title: Learn–forget test
q8.instruction: Recall whether you can still remember a new name or number a week after learning it.
q8.ariaLabel: Memory test: an animation showing the memory level filling up and fading

H.label: Learns fast, forgets
H.description: Picks it up on the spot but has forgotten it a week later.

S.label: Learns fast, remembers
S.description: Picks it up quickly and remembers it well for a long time.

B.label: Learns slowly, doesn't forget
B.description: Slow to pick up, but once learned never forgets.

q9.title: Stress test
q9.instruction: Recall your very first reaction when a sudden problem comes up.
q9.ariaLabel: Emotion test: an animation showing a facial expression changing

H.label: Anxious
H.description: Worries, gets anxious and keeps changing decisions.

S.label: Sharp
S.description: Quick to anger but takes decisive action.

B.label: Calm
B.description: Takes it calmly and steadily, but sometimes becomes sluggish.

q10.title: Warmth test
q10.instruction: Place your palm on your neck or cheek and feel whether it is warm or cold.
q10.ariaLabel: Hands and feet test: an animation of placing a palm on the cheek to feel its warmth

H.label: Cold, dry
H.description: The hand feels cold and dry — especially in winter.

S.label: Hot, sweaty
S.description: The hand is warm, even hot; the palm sweats easily.

B.label: Cool, moist
B.description: The hand feels cool and softly moist.

q11.title: Stairs test
q11.instruction: Recall how your body feels after climbing three flights of stairs or walking briskly for 30 minutes.
q11.ariaLabel: Stamina test: an animation showing how energy drops while climbing stairs

H.label: Tires quickly
H.description: Fast at first, but soon tired and out of breath.

S.label: Average
S.description: Handles moderate effort steadily and well.

B.label: Very enduring
B.description: Handles long effort easily, without tiring.

q12.title: Bowel rhythm and stool observation
q12.instruction: Recall how regular your bowel movements were last week and what your stools were like.
q12.ariaLabel: Bowel test: an animation showing how regular the weekly rhythm is and the shape of the stools

H.label: Irregular, hard
H.description: An irregular rhythm; stools are hard and lumpy (pellet-like).

S.label: Regular, soft
S.description: Regular every day; stools are soft and normally formed.

B.label: Slow, bulky
B.description: Once every two days but large; stools are thick, with a bloated feeling.
